summary.intent: Fix a bug where a configured registry destination in callisto.toml (a cargo registry url, or an npm registry url used with yarn) was silently ignored so releases could publish to a different registry than configured; also finalize the prior E320 PR.
summary.outcome: Added guards that reject a cargo registry url with E254 and stop yarn npm publishing with E168 when an npm registry url is set, with tests (mutation-checked), docs, changeset and a REL-PUB-18 spec criterion. Branch was committed and pushed, and a tracking trail was created; full workspace tests and clippy passed.

repo: Config rejections of unsupported keys follow the existing UnknownKey (E254) pattern that explains why; unsupported release features use E168 (UnsupportedReleaseFeature).
docs/specs/release.json holds acceptance criteria grouped into id families like REL-PUB-NN; new behavior gets a new criterion (here REL-PUB-18 after REL-PUB-17).
Each change needs a .changeset/*.md file with a 'callisto-cli: patch' frontmatter, plus updates to docs/config.md and docs/publishing.md.
Cargo takes its destination only from .cargo/config.toml; yarn npm publish has no --registry flag and needs npmPublishRegistry in .yarnrc.yml.
Existing tests used a cargo registry url as sample data (config/resolve.rs line ~1425) and had to be changed to an npm registry once the guard was added.
Verification routine is cargo fmt, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, cargo clippy -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace.

code.finding: A sample config in a test used kind=cargo with a url; it broke under the new E254 guard and was switched to kind=npm with url https://corp.example/.
The npm publish path checks package_manager == Yarn with an operation; it needed the qualified registry_argv::NpmPackageManager::Yarn path to compile after the guard was added.
The argv builder contains the test every_package_manager_gets_only_the_publish_flags, which covers the claim that yarn rejects --registry.

workflow: Mutation check: temporarily break each guard with a script, confirm its test fails, then restore and rerun the full suite.
Use python3 -I scripts with exact-count assertions for multi-line doc and spec edits so replacements fail loudly if the target text shifts.
Pipe cargo test output through grep/awk to summarize suite counts instead of reading full output.

friction: Initial cargo check failed because the yarn comparison in npm.rs needed a qualified enum path, requiring a follow-up sed fix.
An existing test using a cargo registry url as sample data failed after the new guard and had to be adjusted.

The changeset was written to a path in a different worktree (macos-15-runners) in one step and the docs update had to be redone via a script, so the first clippy/test run in that command was repeated.
open_items: Yarn users must set npmPublishRegistry in .yarnrc.yml themselves; Callisto does not translate the configured registry url for yarn.
PR for fix/registry-destination-not-ignored was prepared (pr-registry.md) but opening it was not shown in the transcript.
